applicableAreas: Southern property boundary where overhead electric line is shown
findings.comment: Buildings 7 and 8 are located near the overhead electric line shown on the southern property boundary. However, no surveyed elevations of overhead conductors, no dimension lines showing clearances from the outside conductor to building faces, and no building elevation sheets are provided. The 7 feet 6 inches horizontal sky-to-ground clearance requirement cannot be verified without registered surveyor data and dimensioned elevation views.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary where overhead electric line is located
findings.comment: The site plan shows overhead electric lines along the southern boundary but does not identify the conductor type (primary, neutral, or secondary) or voltage classification (distribution vs. transmission). No radial clearance zones are dimensioned on plan or section views. The 15-foot radial clearance requirement from the outside conductor cannot be verified without conductor identification and dimensioned clearance exhibits.

applicableAreas: Buildings 7 and 8 on southern portion of site near overhead electric line
findings.comment: No building elevation or section views are provided showing building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies) relative to the overhead electric line. Building elevations and cross-sections with surveyed conductor elevations and clearance dimensions are required but not submitted.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary where overhead electric line exists adjacent to site
findings.comment: The overhead electric line exists along the southern right-of-way adjacent to the site. Buildings 7 and 8 are nearest this line. However, no dimensioned clearance verification showing the 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from the outside conductor is provided. Building elevation sheets with surveyed conductor location data and clearance dimension annotations are required but not submitted.

applicableAreas: Buildings 7 and 8 on southern portion of site
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets are provided showing surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors. Building elevations with registered surveyor data for conductor elevation, pole location, and dimensioned clearance verification are required by code but not submitted.

applicableAreas: Buildings 7 and 8 near overhead electric line at southern boundary
findings.comment: Section and plan view exhibits with dimensions from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of buildings and building projections are not provided. No clearance verification dimensions are shown on any section views, elevation views, or enlarged plan details.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls around perimeter and pond at southern portion of site
findings.comment: Retaining walls are shown on the site plan (Sheet 38-39) and the Landscape Plan indicates a 'Begin Concrete Retaining Wall' along the southern property line near the overhead electric line. However, no dimension lines or clearance annotations showing the 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from the outside electric line to the wall face are provided on any section views or plan details.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls along southern property boundary
findings.comment: Retaining walls are shown on the site plan in proximity to the overhead electric line, but section exhibits with dimensions from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of the wall are not provided. No clearance dimension annotations are shown on retaining wall section views.

applicableAreas: Driveway entrance at southern property boundary
findings.comment: The site plan shows a driveway entrance at the southern property boundary where the overhead electric line is located. No vertical clearance dimensions are shown on the grading plan or section views. No profile sections demonstrate that the driveway maintains the minimum 16-foot vertical clearance (for parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot vertical clearance (for areas with truck traffic) from the lowest point of overhead electric facilities. Registered surveyor mid-span clearance data required by code is not provided.

applicableAreas: If transmission lines exist on or cross the property
findings.comment: Sheet 3 general notes reference electric transmission facilities and down guy anchors, suggesting transmission lines (≥60kV) may exist on or adjacent to the property. However, the overhead electric line shown on the existing conditions survey is not clearly identified as transmission or distribution. If transmission lines are present, grading plan and utility plan with final grade elevations and 30-foot vertical clearance dimensions are required but not provided.

applicableAreas: If overhead electric poles conflict with proposed driveway
findings.comment: The site plan shows a driveway entrance near the southern property boundary where overhead electric poles are shown. However, the exact location of the utility pole(s) relative to the driveway edge is not dimensioned. Without clear dimension lines showing the distance from the driveway edge to the utility pole centerline, it cannot be verified whether the pole is within 30 feet of the driveway or if relocation is required.

applicableAreas: Overhead electric line shown on site plan
findings.comment: The site plan shows the overhead electric line (labeled 'OHE') but contains no dimension lines or clearance annotations from the outside conductor to any site features (buildings, driveways, walls, etc.). All clearance dimensions that appear on the plan are measured from other references, not from the conductor. Zero clearance dimensions from the outside conductor are provided, violating UCM § 1.10.3 requirement.

applicableAreas: Proposed development within electric easements at southern property boundary
findings.comment: The site plan shows electric easements (5' Electric Easements labeled on boundaries) and overhead distribution lines along the southern boundary. A retaining wall is shown along this boundary. The code prohibits customer facilities under/over overhead distribution lines and requires 7.5-foot clearance for items within electric easements. Without dimensioned clearance verification from the outside conductor to the retaining wall and other features, compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Driveway entrance at southern boundary and buildings near overhead electric line
findings.comment: The driveway appears to pass under or very near the overhead electric line at the southern boundary, and the clearance appears marginal based on visual inspection of the plan. Registered surveyor mid-span clearance data showing pole locations and vertical clearances from the overhead line to the driveway finish grade is required by code but not provided.

applicableAreas: Landscape areas adjacent to overhead electric line at southern boundary
findings.comment: The landscape plan shows trees planted adjacent to the overhead electric line at the southern property boundary. The tree species are not identified on the landscape plan—trees are labeled only by category (SY, M, PL, P). Compliance with the requirement that trees within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors or 50 lateral feet of overhead transmission conductors must be from the ECM Appendix F Utility Compatible list cannot be verified. Tree species must be identified with species names verified against ECM Appendix F.

applicableAreas: Accessible paths and driveways near utility poles at southern boundary
findings.comment: The existing conditions survey shows utility poles with guy wire symbols (guy anchors), and the driveway passes near this area. However, the specific locations of down guy wires relative to accessible paths and driveways are not clearly dimensioned on the site plan. Down guy anchor locations and conflicts with site features cannot be definitively verified from submitted plans.

applicableAreas: If angled guy anchors from transmission structures exist
findings.comment: Sheet 3 transmission notes reference transmission structures and requirements for down guy clearances. However, it is not clearly documented whether angled transmission guy easements exist requiring dedicated 10-foot-wide easements with 50-foot extensions beyond anchor. No guy easement exhibit is provided showing such easement boundaries if required.

applicableAreas: Distribution pole down guy anchors if present
findings.comment: The existing conditions survey shows utility poles and guy anchor symbols, but the exact locations of down guy anchor points and whether dedicated easements exist are not clearly documented on the submitted plans. Down guy anchor easement details with 10-foot width and 5-foot extension past ground entry cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Construction staging areas and equipment operation zones near overhead electric line
findings.comment: The site plan includes general construction and demolition notes but does not show a detailed site logistics plan or construction phasing plan depicting staging areas, equipment laydown zones, crane swing radius, or work platforms. The 10-foot radial clearance from energized overhead electric lines during construction (OSHA requirement) cannot be verified without a construction logistics plan.

applicableAreas: Entire site with overhead electric lines
findings.comment: A required note that the owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003 is not clearly visible on the cover sheet or general notes. While transmission safety notes are on Sheet 3, the specific 48-hour notification requirement for general overhead work is not documented.
